input: Mere ghutne mein dard hai aur Tiger Balm lagata hu
message: Ghutne ke dard mein dard badhane wali activity kam karein. Kapde mein lapeta cold pack madad kar sakta hai; ice seedhe skin par na lagayein. Kuch adults ke liye paracetamol OTC pain-relief option hai, har cause ka ilaaj nahi. Product label aur pharmacist se suitability confirm karein, khaaskar liver/kidney problem, allergy, heavy alcohol use ya doosri medicines mein; do paracetamol wale products saath na lein. Bachchon ki advice alag hai. Garam/laal ghutne ke saath bukhar, pair par weight na rakh pana ya badi chot mein urgent assessment chahiye.
question: Patient ki umar kitni hai?
